frozen_fixture: Real Kernel setup once per case, PostgreSQL 17 CREATE DATABASE TEMPLATE plus object copies per arm. Credentials pass only in private process memory.

sample_interpretation.effective_calls: Validated HTTP 200 operations excluding duplicate commit receipts; expected semantic conflicts are accounted for in terminal business outcomes, not in effective RPS.
sample_interpretation.business_fraction: For mixed HTTP, terminal validated 200 or expected shared-resource conflict divided by all planned logical operations, including never-emitted downstream work. For read-only HTTP, validated reads divided by scheduled reads.
sample_interpretation.server_arrivals: Count and first-to-last monotonic time at the common ASGI boundary before admission. A failed transport can produce no ASGI request.
sample_interpretation.client_header_rps: Application-observed HTTPX request-header-send starts; distinct from client scheduling and successful completions.
sample_interpretation.lock_samples: Sampled wait_event_type=Lock connections; zero sampled locks cannot exclude shorter waits.
sample_interpretation.profile_replay_events: Full replay wrapper only. A warm suffix still applies the new event and inspects/hashes the old prefix; zero full-replay events does not imply zero state work.
sample_interpretation.rate_target: Original overload target 1000 RPS and required valid responses retained; bounded 10 RPS mixed and 20 RPS 600-second read provide different tests.
sample_interpretation.duration_limits: 600 seconds per tested arm; no claim of multi-hour soak or production hardware parity.

attribution.note: First A pilot predates final whole-chain instrumentation. On history-1 repeat1 only git metadata initially showed A0 although imported tracked source hashes match the frozen version. All comparisons in summary exclude repeat1 on every attribution case.

cases: 2-event repair with D10 causal parent, D20 replacement, distinct reviewer and promotion
retcon.note: Counters, full-source, selection and state equivalence are primary. Shared single-core lab timings are descriptive.

exact.note: Canonical request digests compared for every query/propose/prepare/accept/retry stage; same fixed earlier approval, certificate and proposal on both cloned arms.

ablation.note: Shared host and overlapping single-core workloads. Structural work counts identify flag attribution; timing estimates are exploratory.

capacity.note: Main separate fixture pairs per case. First A of open-1000 and mixed-50 predates additional server and PG CPU counters; cite open-repeat and mixed50-repeat for instrument-matched pairs. Hotspot here means 80% shared-subject, ordinary paced traffic; consult ci-overload-repeat for full burst.

mixed50-repeat.note: Dedicated instrument-matched A/B for 50 logical agents.

open-repeat.note: 5,000 fixed byte-identical state reads, 1,000/s target, two API workers, no retries or writes.

ci-overload.note: Stress/exploratory only. First arm shared CPU6 with large history generation and ablation. Compile-stage budget exhaustion prevented 1,941 downstream emissions; offered traffic differs materially. No acceleration inference.

ci-overload-repeat.note: Original 200-agent mixed pipeline plus 5 x 200 hot read burst requests. Both full paired arms progress to commits. Independent of the single-core exploratory comparison.

ablation-http.note: Same candidate SHA and fixture. Bounded mixed only. Cannot isolate a 200/500/1000-agent independent-flag effect from it.

stability-repeat.note: 600 seconds, 20 requests/s, 12,000 scheduled each. A overlapped a separate CPU7 large-history campaign; interpret descriptive differences accordingly. Original stable client only records dispatch starts.

stability-headers.note: Same 600-second public workload with additional HTTPX wire-header and ASGI counters; primary two-core comparison for matching actual sender and receiver rates.

shared_host: Affinities pin PG, service workers and load generator together within each campaign. Other operations still share OS/storage/hardware, so single-pair wall time is not a causal significance test.
